dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a natural number n, this is the type of real n-by-n matrices, represented as functions Fin n -> Fin n -> Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It types A and deltaA as square real matrices of the same dimension n.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a natural number n, this is the type of real vectors indexed by Fin n, namely functions Fin n -> Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It types b, deltaB, and x as real n-dimensional vectors.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: It returns the norm of a square real matrix in the Frobenius normed-ring structure; for A this is ||A||_F = sqrt(sum_i sum_j A_ij^2).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the matrix factor on the right-hand side exactly the Frobenius norm ||deltaA||_F.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: It is matrix-vector multiplication: for a matrix A and vector x, its ith component is sum over all j in Fin n of A_ij x_j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets both (A + deltaA)x in the hypothesis and Ax in the residual.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: It is the residual vector b - Ax, with subtraction performed componentwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The left-hand side of the conclusion is the Euclidean norm of the residual b - Ax.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: It is the Euclidean vector norm ||v||_2 = sqrt(sum_i v_i^2), where the sum ranges over Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the norms ||b - Ax||_2, ||x||_2, and ||deltaB||_2 appearing in the inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: It is exact equality between two terms of the same type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The perturbed linear-system hypothesis is exact vector equality, not an approximation or tolerance condition.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin n is the finite index type with n elements, conventionally identified with 0 through n-1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It indexes every row, column, vector component, and finite sum.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: It projects the heterogeneous addition operation supplied by an HAdd instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the explicit instances, it denotes ordinary pointwise matrix addition, pointwise vector addition, and ordinary real addition.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: It projects the heterogeneous multiplication operation supplied by an HMul instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the explicit real instance, it denotes ordinary multiplication in matrix-vector summands and in ||deltaA||_F ||x||_2.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: It projects the less-than-or-equal relation supplied by an LE instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With Real.instLE, it makes the conclusion an inequality in the usual order on real numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.add
dependency_coverage.meaning: It equips matrices with pointwise addition inherited from addition of their entries.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes (A + deltaA)_ij equal to A_ij + deltaA_ij in the perturbed system.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: It is the type of natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The universally quantified natural number n determines the dimension and may be zero.

dependency_coverage.name: Pi.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: It defines addition of dependent functions pointwise: (f + g)(i) = f(i) + g(i).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes b + deltaB pointwise vector addition and underlies pointwise matrix addition.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: It is the type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All matrix entries, vector components, norms, products, sums, and inequalities are real-valued.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: It supplies ordinary real-number addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines scalar addition and the entrywise additions lifted to matrices and vectors.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: It supplies the usual less-than-or-equal relation on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the ordering used in the final norm bound.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: It supplies ordinary real-number multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines multiplication of matrix entries by vector components and multiplication of the two norms on the right-hand side.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: It converts an ordinary Add instance into the corresponding homogeneous HAdd instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It ensures every displayed heterogeneous addition is the ordinary addition supplied for the relevant real, vector, or matrix type.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: It converts an ordinary Mul instance into the corresponding homogeneous HMul instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It ensures the displayed scalar products are ordinary real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: It provides the canonical finite enumeration of all elements of Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits sums over every vector coordinate and matrix column, including empty sums when n = 0.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.sum
dependency_coverage.meaning: It sums the values of a function over a finite set in an additive commutative monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It computes matrix-vector products and the finite sums of coordinate squares used by the vector norm.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.univ
dependency_coverage.meaning: It is the finite set containing every element of a finite type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes each sum range over all indices in Fin n rather than a proper subset.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: It projects the exponentiation operation supplied by an HPow instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Here it raises each real coordinate to the natural-number power 2 in the Euclidean norm formula.

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: It projects the heterogeneous subtraction operation supplied by an HSub instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the pointwise function instance, it forms the residual vector b - Ax component by component.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix
dependency_coverage.meaning: A matrix with row type m, column type n, and entries in alpha is represented as a function m -> n -> alpha.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the interpretation of A_ij, deltaA_ij, and all pointwise matrix operations.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.frobeniusNormedRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: It equips square matrices over an RCLike scalar field with the normed-ring structure whose norm is the Frobenius norm.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its norm field is explicitly selected for deltaA, so the theorem uses the Frobenius matrix norm rather than an operator norm.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: It supplies natural-number exponentiation in a monoid by repeated multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For real numbers, it makes each coordinate power v_i^2 equal the ordinary square v_i v_i.

dependency_coverage.name: Norm.norm
dependency_coverage.meaning: It projects the real-valued norm function from a Norm instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It extracts the matrix norm from the explicitly selected Frobenius normed-ring structure.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedRing.toNorm
dependency_coverage.meaning: It extracts the Norm structure contained in a NormedRing instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects Matrix.frobeniusNormedRing to the norm operation used in LocalDef003.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: It interprets a natural-number literal in a type having the corresponding OfNat instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the exponent literal 2 as a natural number.

dependency_coverage.name: Pi.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: It defines subtraction of functions pointwise: (f - g)(i) = f(i) - g(i).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the residual b - Ax the vector whose ith component is b_i - (Ax)_i.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: It supplies the additive commutative monoid structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It validates the finite real sums used in matrix-vector multiplication and vector norms.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: It supplies the multiplicative monoid structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It provides natural powers of real coordinates, particularly their squares.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instRCLike
dependency_coverage.meaning: It supplies the RCLike structure on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits construction of the Frobenius normed-ring instance for real square matrices; it introduces no additional hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: It supplies ordinary real subtraction, defined as addition of the additive inverse.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines each component b_i - (Ax)_i of the residual vector.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.sqrt
dependency_coverage.meaning: It is the nonnegative real square-root function; on the nonnegative sums of squares here it is the ordinary principal square root.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It converts each sum of coordinate squares into the Euclidean vector norm.

dependency_coverage.name: instDecidableEqFin
dependency_coverage.meaning: It supplies decidable equality for indices in Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports the Frobenius matrix norm structure and finite-index constructions without imposing a mathematical assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: instHPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: It converts a Pow instance into the corresponding HPow instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects real natural-number exponentiation to the coordinate-square notation used in LocalDef006.

dependency_coverage.name: instHSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: It converts an ordinary Sub instance into the corresponding homogeneous HSub instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects pointwise vector subtraction to the subtraction operation used in the residual definition.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: It interprets each natural-number literal n as that same element of Nat.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the exponent literal 2 exactly the natural number two.

binders: Two real n-by-n matrices A and deltaA.
Three real n-dimensional vectors b, deltaB, and x.
hypotheses: The vector x satisfies the perturbed system (A + deltaA)x = b + deltaB exactly; equivalently, for every i in Fin n, sum_j (A_ij + deltaA_ij)x_j = b_i + deltaB_i.
conclusions: The Euclidean residual norm satisfies ||b - Ax||_2 <= ||deltaA||_F ||x||_2 + ||deltaB||_2.
mathematical_definitions: Fin n is the n-element coordinate set {0, ..., n-1}.
For a matrix M and vector v, (Mv)_i = sum over j in Fin n of M_ij v_j.
Matrix and vector addition, and vector subtraction, are pointwise.
The residual is r(A,b,x) = b - Ax.
For a real vector v, ||v||_2 = sqrt(sum over i in Fin n of v_i^2).
For a real matrix M, ||M||_F is its Frobenius norm, sqrt(sum over i and j in Fin n of M_ij^2).
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every dimension n, every pair of real n-by-n matrices A and deltaA, and every three real n-vectors b, deltaB, and x, if x is an exact solution of the perturbed linear system (A + deltaA)x = b + deltaB, then its residual for the unperturbed system Ax = b has Euclidean norm at most the Frobenius norm of deltaA times the Euclidean norm of x, plus the Euclidean norm of deltaB.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The dimension n is unrestricted and may be zero. When n = 0, all relevant sums are empty and the norm inequality reduces to 0 <= 0.
The statement is conditional. For values not satisfying (A + deltaA)x = b + deltaB, the implication is vacuously true and gives no residual bound.
No invertibility, nonsingularity, rank, conditioning, or spectral assumption is imposed on A or A + deltaA.
No existence or uniqueness of x is asserted; x is merely any vector satisfying the displayed exact equation.
No smallness, relative-size, or nonzero assumptions are imposed on deltaA, deltaB, b, or x.
The matrix norm is specifically the Frobenius norm, not the induced Euclidean operator norm.
The vector norms are explicitly finite-dimensional Euclidean norms, not the default function-space norm.
The perturbation convention in the hypothesis is b + deltaB. Under that hypothesis, b - Ax = deltaA x - deltaB.
The proposition concerns square real matrices only; it does not encode complex scalars, rectangular matrices, or infinite-dimensional spaces.
No floating-point computation, rounding model, algorithm, computed-solution status, forward error, relative backward error, or error tolerance is encoded.
